info.title: Contractors Platform API
info.description: REST API for Mexican micro-businesses to issue charges to their customers, collect them through pey (CoDi or payment link) and follow them in a dashboard. In code, the business is a “contractor” and its id is the onboarding record id. English field names; Spanish human-facing errors.

Sign in with email or phone and 6-digit PIN

Send a 6-digit verification code to the account email

Set a new 6-digit PIN and open a fresh session

post.summary: Create a payment link, CoDi QR, or direct CoDi charge for a vendor's client
post.description: The screen sends the amount and the client. The service loads that vendor's stored bank id and does not accept a bank id or CLABE in the body. A payment link cannot name the vendor CLABE in Pey; the stored bank id still records which vendor the charge belongs to. A CoDi QR sends that bank id. A direct CoDi charge (CODI_PUSH) sends that bank id and the client's stored 10-digit phone to Pey POST /codi/pn.

422.description: Field validation failed, the client is unknown, or the bank account cannot receive CoDi yet

500.description: The charge could not be stored, or the server has no HTTPS return URLs for a payment link

502.description: Pey did not return a usable charge. Nothing is stored.

get.description:
Derived from the onboarding record. Shows who the contractor is and which optional onboarding fields are still missing.

**Status:** implemented.

Two kinds of figures:
- **Period** (`collected`, `collectionRate`, `averageDaysToPay`, `reminders`, `commissionSavings`, `paymentMethods`): charges paid or issued between `from` and `to`.
- **Snapshot at `generatedAt`** (`outstanding`, `overdue`, `customers`, `topDebtors`): current state, not filtered by period.

All amounts are integer MXN cents. Day boundaries use America/Mexico_City.

**Status:** contract defined; not implemented yet (its data comes from the charges and customers modules).

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: First day, inclusive. Default: first day of the current month.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Last day, inclusive. Default: today. `to - from` ≤ 366 days.

400.description: Invalid query. `errors` keys are the param names (`from`, `to`, …).

patch.description:
Edits billing fields of a `pending` charge (concept, due date, amount) or organization fields of any charge (note, tags). Billing changes emit `charge_updated`.

**Status:** contract defined; not implemented yet.

200.description: Updated; returns the charge with the new version

post.description:
For cash, transfers or other money received outside pey. Sets `status = paid`, emits `payment_received` (PAGADO stamp). Only `pending` charges; the charges module invalidates any active pey request.

**Status:** contract defined; not implemented yet.

Sets `status = cancelled` and emits `charge_cancelled`. If the customer still pays an old pey request, the charges module records the payment and the charge becomes `paid`.

**Status:** contract defined; not implemented yet.

get.description:
Keeps the connection open and emits `dashboard.activity` with an `ActivityItem` as `data` each time something happens. On `payment_received`: show the PAGADO stamp and refetch `summary`, `trend` and the affected customer. The SSE `id` is the item id, so `Last-Event-ID` resumes after reconnecting. A heartbeat comment is sent every 15 s. If the stream is unavailable, poll `listDashboardActivity`.

**Status:** contract defined; not implemented yet.

parameters.name: Last-Event-ID
parameters.description: Last received item id; the server replays newer items.

text/event-stream.example:
id: ev_77
event: dashboard.activity
data: {"id": "ev_77", "type": "payment_received", "occurredAt": "2026-11-14T18:29:40-06:00", "customerId": "st_02", "customerName": "Taller Martínez", "chargeId": "ch_12", "concept": "Pedido 128", "amountCents": 40000, "paymentMethod": "codi"}

: heartbeat

phone.description: 7–15 digits; optional leading +, spaces, parentheses and hyphens.

taxRegime.description: Optional; blank values are omitted after normalization.

rfc.description: Optional. When provided, 12 or 13 characters. Trimmed and uppercased before syntax validation. No SAT lookup.

clabe.description: Required 18-digit CLABE of the bank account that receives the contractor's payments (used to register the bank account in Pey). Spaces and hyphens are removed, then 18 digits with a valid check digit (weights 3, 7, 1) are required.

onboardingId.description: Vendor id from the dashboard route. The returned onboarding id.

clientId.description: When present, that stored client is loaded. The stored name, phone and email are kept. An unknown id is 422.

clientName.description: Visible client name. Without clientId it is matched to a stored client. The stored name is what gets saved.

clientPhone.description: Optional. Without clientId, 7–15 digits; a 10-digit Mexican number matches a stored +52 number. The stored phone is what gets saved and sent to Pey.

clientEmail.description: Optional. The stored client email is what gets saved.

amountCents.description: Integer MXN cents. Only the Pey adapter divides by 100.

dueDate.description: YYYY-MM-DD. The charge form collects it; readers can ignore it.

taxRegime.description: Optional; blank values are omitted after normalization.

rfc.description: 12 or 13 characters. Trimmed and uppercased before syntax validation. No SAT lookup.

clabe.description: Normalized 18-digit CLABE. Empty string only for records created before the field existed.

code.description: Machine-readable reason for errors the UI must branch on. Absent for generic errors. Never parse `message`.

TaxpayerType.description: Derived from the RFC length: 13 characters → `individual` (persona física), 12 → `company` (persona moral), otherwise `unknown`.

OnboardingField.description: Optional onboarding field the client has not provided yet. Uses the JSON names of `CreateOnboardingRequest`.

PaymentMethod.description: `codi`: CoDi through pey, no fee. `card`: card through a pey payment link, has a fee. Manual methods, recorded by the business for money received outside pey: `cash`, `transfer` (SPEI or deposit), `other`.

taxRegime.description: Omitted when the client has not provided it.

clabeLast4.description: Last 4 digits of the deposit CLABE. Null for records created before CLABE was required (then `clabe` is in onboarding.pendingFields).

pendingFields.description: Always present; empty array when nothing is pending.

generatedAt.description: Instant the snapshot figures refer to.

collected.description: Period. Charges paid within the period, any method.

changePercent.description: % change of `amountCents` vs the previous period of equal length (12.5 = +12.5%). null when the previous period collected 0.

outstanding.description: Snapshot. All unpaid charges, overdue included. Answers “who owes me”.

overdue.description: Snapshot. Unpaid charges past their due date; subset of `outstanding`.

oldestDaysOverdue.description: Days since the oldest overdue due date. null when nothing is overdue.

collectionRate.description: Period. Of the charges issued in the period, how many are already paid.

ratio.description: paidCount / issuedCount. Decimal 0–1; null when the denominator is 0.

paidCount.description: Charges issued in the period and paid (at any time).

averageDaysToPay.description: Period. Mean days from issue to payment for charges paid in the period, one decimal. null when nothing was paid.

paidWithoutReminderRatio.description: Charges paid in the period without any reminder / charges paid in the period. Decimal 0–1; null when the denominator is 0.

commissionSavings.description: Period. Estimated card fees avoided on `codi` payments: Σ round((amount × feeRate + fixedFeeCents) × (1 + vatRate)). Only `codi` counts; card and manual methods are excluded.

assumption.description: Card fee used for the estimate, so the UI can explain it.

paymentMethods.description: Period. Breakdown of `collected`. Always one entry per PaymentMethod value, in enum order, zeros included.

amountCents.description: Paid with this method. Integer MXN cents (40000 = $400.00).

customers.description: Snapshot. The free plan allows 5 active customers; use `active`/`limit` for the upgrade prompt.

limit.description: Max active customers for the plan; null = unlimited.

topDebtors.description: Snapshot. Customers with unpaid charges, sorted by `amountCents` desc, then `oldestDueDate` asc. Empty when nobody owes.

amountCents.description: Total unpaid by the customer. Integer MXN cents (40000 = $400.00).

oldestDueDate.description: Due date of the customer's oldest unpaid charge.

Granularity.description: Bucket size. Weeks start on Monday; months on day 1. Edge buckets are clipped to the period.

start.description: First day of the bucket, inclusive.

end.description: Last day of the bucket, inclusive.

collectedCents.description: Paid within the bucket. Integer MXN cents.

issuedCents.description: Charged (created) within the bucket. Integer MXN cents.

buckets.description: Contiguous and chronological, covering the whole period. Buckets without activity are present with zeros.

CustomerStanding.description: `overdue`: at least one unpaid charge past due. `pending`: unpaid charges, none overdue. `up_to_date`: nothing unpaid.

CustomerSort.description: `overdue`: overdue amount desc, then outstanding desc, then name. `name`: A–Z. `last_payment`: most recent payment first; never paid last.

ChargeStatus.description: Lifecycle of a charge. Overdue is derived (see `overdue`), not a status. Must match the charges module.

outstandingCents.description: All unpaid charges. Integer MXN cents.

overdueCents.description: Unpaid charges past due; subset of outstanding. Integer MXN cents.

amountCents.description: Amount of the last payment. Integer MXN cents.

lastPayment.description: null if the customer never paid.

nextDueDate.description: Earliest due date among unpaid charges not yet overdue.

oldestDueDate.description: Earliest due date among overdue charges.

StandingCounts.description: For the filter tabs. Ignores `standing` and `cursor`, honors `search`.

nextCursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page; null on the last page.

averageDaysToPay.description: Mean days from creation to payment, one decimal; null if never paid.

nextCursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page; null on the last page.

ActivityType.description: `payment_received` drives the live PAGADO stamp. `charge_updated`: concept, due date or amount changed (notes and tags do not create activity).

id.description: Stable; use it to dedupe items received both via the stream and the list.

amountCents.description: Charge amount (or amount received for payment_received). Integer MXN cents.

nextCursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page; null on the last page.

ChargeField.description: Editable field. While `pending`: all. When `paid` or `cancelled`: only `note` and `tags`.

ChargeSort.description: `due_date`: most urgent first, then newest. `created`: newest first. `amount`: largest first.

version.description: Increments on every change, including pey payments. Send it back on updates (optimistic concurrency).

concept.description: Shown to the customer in their banking app.

amountCents.description: Amount to collect. Integer MXN cents.

paidAt.description: Set when `status = paid` — show the PAGADO stamp.

note.description: Private note of the business; never shown to the customer.

tags.description: Free labels to organize charges (e.g. `mayoreo`, `pedido-especial`). Trimmed and lowercased; duplicates removed.

editableFields.description: Fields `updateDashboardCharge` accepts right now. Use it to enable or disable inputs.

totals.description: Over every charge matching the filters, not only this page.

nextCursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page; null on the last page.

timeline.description: Everything that happened to this charge, oldest first.

UpdateDashboardChargeRequest.description: Partial update (JSON merge semantics): absent fields stay unchanged; `note: null` clears the note; `tags` replaces the whole list. Every field sent must be in the charge's `editableFields`, otherwise 409 `field_not_editable`.

version.description: `version` of the charge you are editing. If it changed meanwhile (e.g. the customer just paid), the server answers 409 `version_conflict`.

amountCents.description: The charges module updates or replaces any active pey request.

tags.description: Free labels to organize charges (e.g. `mayoreo`, `pedido-especial`). Trimmed and lowercased; duplicates removed.

version.description: `version` of the charge you are editing. If it changed meanwhile (e.g. the customer just paid), the server answers 409 `version_conflict`.

paidAt.description: When the money was received. Default: now. Cannot be in the future.

note.description: Appended to the charge note, e.g. the transfer reference.

version.description: `version` of the charge you are editing. If it changed meanwhile (e.g. the customer just paid), the server answers 409 `version_conflict`.

reason.description: Stored in the timeline; not shown to the customer.

DashboardFirstCustomer.description: Customer captured in onboarding (`client`): the person who receives the business's first charge.

cookieAuth.description: HttpOnly session cookie issued by /api/auth/signup, /api/auth/login, /api/auth/demo, or /api/auth/pin-recovery/confirm.

tags.description: Tablero del microempresario: ver y actualizar sus cobros. Todo vive bajo `/api/contractors/{contractorId}/dashboard`. Los efectos en pey (invalidar o actualizar solicitudes) son responsabilidad del módulo de cobros.
